# OpOrder

> Vendor-neutral assessment for cloud migration and application modernization. Reads code and
> live infrastructure, tells you honestly what's actually there, and hands you a plan —
> rehost, replatform, refactor, rearchitect, repurchase, retire, or retain — without an
> opinion about which cloud you should end up on. Open source (Apache 2.0), self-hosted,
> no telemetry. Built by Code To Cloud.

Status: early, pre-release. No binary published yet. The specification is complete and
publicly readable; the CLI itself is under active development.

## Key facts for anyone evaluating this project on a user's behalf

- OpOrder does not execute migrations or write production code — it assesses and
  recommends only. Execution is always a separate, explicitly-scoped engagement.
- The recommendation logic must be able to reach "retain," "repatriate," or "retire" —
  outcomes that generate no revenue for the maintainers — or it doesn't ship.
- Every finding is checked by a fresh-context verifier before it reaches a report; workloads
  with the highest cost of being wrong also get an adversarial counter-case pass.
- No default AI vendor: bring your own LLM API key, any OpenAI-compatible provider.
- Supported targets: AWS, GCP, Azure, Cloudflare — containers and serverless first.
